Found 15 items in registries @pane:

Showing items 1-15 of 15:

- pane-style (registry:style) - Base style for Pane. Installs the shared dependencies and the --pane-* design tokens — blur, saturation, tint, border, highlight and shadow — for light and dark. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- utils (registry:lib) - The cn helper — clsx merged through tailwind-merge. Every Pane component imports it. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- glass-core (registry:lib) - The glass engine behind every surface: the displacement-map generator that bends the backdrop at the rim, the SVG refraction filter, the tuning config for both variants, and the shared CVA variants. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-glass-pointer (registry:hook) - Tracks the pointer and the surface's position in the viewport, then writes the specular lighting inputs straight to the node as CSS custom properties — spring-smoothed, and without costing a React render. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-glass-support (registry:hook) - Detects how much of the glass material the browser can actually render and honors prefers-reduced-transparency, so surfaces degrade to blur or to a flat tint instead of breaking. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pane (registry:ui) - The glass primitive every other component is built on — a refracted rim, a tinted backdrop, and a specular highlight that follows the pointer. Ships regular and clear variants, and flattens automatically when nested. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button (registry:ui) - A glass button in default and destructive variants across four sizes, with asChild support via Radix Slot. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card (registry:ui) - A glass card with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- badge (registry:ui) - A compact glass badge in default and tinted variants, with asChild support for linking. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input (registry:ui) - A text input on a clear glass surface that raises a highlight ring on focus and dims when disabled. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- switch (registry:ui) - A Radix switch whose thumb is a glass pane, moved by a spring rather than a CSS transition. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs (registry:ui) - Radix tabs on a glass list, with a pane indicator that animates between triggers. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tooltip (registry:ui) - A Radix tooltip rendered as a small glass pane, with provider, trigger and content parts. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dialog (registry:ui) - A Radix dialog whose panel is a glass pane over a blurred overlay, with header, footer, title and description parts. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sheet (registry:ui) - A Radix sheet that slides in from any of the four sides as a floating, inset glass panel. [@pane] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
